caption: The drawing depicts two female figures positioned symmetrically on either side of a central, black, polygonal opening. Both figures are seated with their legs bent and hanging down. Their torsos face forward, and each has one arm extended outward and the other arm bent toward the center, where they both hold a large cornucopia filled with various fruits and leafy greens. The figures have pale skin, dark wavy hair, and wear wreaths of green leaves on their heads. Their attire consists of draped, blue-gray garments with gold accents, tied with a brown sash below the bust. The background consists of vertical wooden planks in a reddish-brown color. The entire scene is set within a rectangular frame with a cream-colored border.
title: Decorative Figures "Peace and Plenty"
